name: Homebound Portal: the portal that was clicked sends whoever steps through to its owner's Hearthstone (#6101)
contract: Report #6101: using the Homebound Portal item (97758) does nothing; no portal appears.

Item 97758 casts Summon Homebound Portal 93186, a 15 second cast with 5 yard range whose TRANS_DOOR effect places gameobject 80775 for 5 minutes and whose description reads 'Heroes that choose to step through are sent to the portal owner's Hearthstone'.
No gameobject_template row for 80775 existed, so nothing was placed.

A character who uses the item must therefore get a Homebound Portal object, and another character who uses that portal must arrive at the owner's bind point, a different continent from where both stood, while the owner stays put.

With two portals standing within reach of each other, the user must arrive at the bind point of the owner of the portal that was clicked, including when a different portal of another owner is nearer to the user.
